api: minimum_wer(logits_or_prediction, targets, *, ignore_index=None, reduction='mean', **params) -> torch.Tensor; params accept ce_weight, eos_token_id, and nbest_size.
description: Expected word edit count over teacher-forced N-best hypotheses, with candidate sequence log probabilities renormalized over the supplied list (Prabhavalkar et al., §3 Eq. (4), §3.2); optional summed reference cross-entropy interpolation follows §3.3 Eq. (8). The implementation uses word-token IDs and accepts logits shaped [B, N+1, T, V].

examples.title: Train candidate-conditioned hypotheses with Minimum WER

name: minimum-wer

parameters.ce_weight: Finite nonnegative weight on the reference sequence's summed token NLL; defaults to 0.01 (paper §3.3 Eq. (8), §5.2).
parameters.eos_token_id: Optional vocabulary ID; EOS contributes to sequence scores and reference NLL, then ends each word sequence (paper §2).
parameters.ignore_index: Optional integer padding ID excluded from sequence scores, reference NLL, and word sequences; defaults to None.
parameters.logits_or_prediction: Floating-point candidate-conditioned logits shaped [B, N+1, T, V]; row 0 is reference teacher-forced logits and rows 1..N are N-best candidate logits.
parameters.nbest_size: Optional positive candidate count that must equal N; defaults to the number of candidate rows minus one.
parameters.reduction: none returns one loss per example; mean or sum reduces the batch (default mean).
parameters.targets: Reference and candidate word-token IDs shaped [B, N+1, T]; ignored positions may be padded and integer-valued floating tensors are accepted.

usage: Bind logits_or_prediction to the model output and targets to the batch with recipe='structured-objective'; pass ce_weight or eos_token_id in loss_kwargs.
